mapper.sql: FROM mes_task_report r LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MIN(source.id) END AS id, CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MIN(source.workshop_code) END AS workshop_code, CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MIN(source.shift_code) END AS shift_code FROM mes_task_arrange source WHERE source.code=r.arrange_code AND source.task_code=r.task_code AND source.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND source.factory_code=r.factory_code AND source.del_flag='0' ) a ON TRUE
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS matched_task_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.status IN ('CREATE','ISSUE','DISPATCH')) AS not_started_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.status='PRODUCT') AS in_progress_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.status IN ('FINISH','CLOSE')) AS finished_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.status IS NULL OR t.status NOT IN ('CREATE','ISSUE','DISPATCH','PRODUCT','FINISH','CLOSE')) AS unknown_status_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mes_produce_task p WHERE p.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND p.factory_code=t.factory_code AND p.task_code=t.code AND p.del_flag='0' AND p.status='PAUSE')) AS paused_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.plan_end_date IS NOT NULL AND ((t.finish_time IS NOT NULL AND t.finish_time > t.plan_end_date) OR (t.finish_time IS NULL AND t.status IN ('CREATE','ISSUE','DISPATCH','PRODUCT') AND t.plan_end_date < #{observedAt}))) AS delayed_count FROM mes_task t WHERE

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ) AS effective_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status='REVERSED') AS reversed_count, COUNT(DISTINCT r.task_code) FILTER (WHERE ) AS distinct_task_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status IS NOT NULL AND r.status NOT IN ('EFFECTIVE','REVERSED')) AS unknown_status_count WHERE

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(r.mat_code,''),'UNKNOWN') AS material_code, COALESCE(NULLIF(r.report_unit,''),'UNKNOWN') AS report_unit, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(r.effective_report_num,r.report_num) IS NULL OR COALESCE(r.effective_report_num,r.report_num)<0)=0 THEN SUM(COALESCE(r.effective_report_num,r.report_num)) END AS reported_quantity, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.quality_released_num IS NULL OR r.quality_released_num<0)=0 THEN SUM(r.quality_released_num) END AS released_quantity, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.quality_pending_num IS NULL OR r.quality_pending_num<0)=0 THEN SUM(r.quality_pending_num) END AS pending_quantity, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.quality_rejected_num IS NULL OR r.quality_rejected_num<0)=0 THEN SUM(r.quality_rejected_num) END AS rejected_quantity, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(r.effective_report_num,r.report_num) IS NULL OR COALESCE(r.effective_report_num,r.report_num)<0 OR r.quality_released_num IS NULL OR r.quality_pending_num IS NULL OR r.quality_rejected_num IS NULL OR r.quality_released_num<0 OR r.quality_pending_num<0 OR r.quality_rejected_num<0) AS incomplete_count WHERE AND GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(r.mat_code,''),'UNKNOWN'),COALESCE(NULLIF(r.report_unit,''),'UNKNOWN') ORDER BY material_code,report_unit
